title: Chapter 692
text:
Ever since Godora failed to kill the Dark-star leader, Han Xiao had not seen the Dark-star leader for many years. No one knew where he was hiding, but now, he had suddenly appeared with a fleet. It seemed like he had made a comeback.

To actually be able to ambush me without any warning …

Han Xiao frowned. The Dark-star leader definitely knew his whereabouts and had an unusual intelligence channel. He should have joined forces with some powerful organization.

Only by getting rid of me will Dark-star have a chance to plot against Godora. The organization that joined forces with Dark-star is probably an organization that occasionally tries to assassinate me. Both parties have the same goal, so they hit it off …

Han Xiaoxin's mind spun quickly. From this, he could deduce that the Dark-star leader definitely had confidence in attacking him. With so many failed assassinations, it was impossible for the other party to not be cautious.

This small fleet before him was basically no threat to him. After all, his Mech Legion was not to be trifled with. However, Han Xiao did not underestimate them at all. Instead, he secretly raised his guard. He felt that the Dark-star leader definitely had some unknown trump cards.

Han Xiao did not have any intention of chatting. His Army Boxes opened, and a huge Mech Legion spread out like a black tide. In terms of numbers, they crushed the Dark-star leader's fleet.

Han Xiao decisively attacked. Countless cannon fire seemed to light up the universe. The storm-like counterattack instantly tore dozens of battleships apart!

With the current size of the Mech Legion, coupled with the various talents and Mechanical Force bonuses of the [Truth Mechanic], Han Xiao alone was a galactic army. One person was enough to destroy a fleet.

Countless mechanical guards and hovering guards surrounded Han Xiao, forming layer after layer of dense shields. The fleet's attacks could not penetrate them at all. They posed no threat at all.

Harrofal was also protected inside. He looked around at the dense mechanical army and could not help but sigh. So rich!

In just a short while, the hundreds of battleships were beaten to a pulp, and almost all of them were wiped out. Han Xiao, however, frowned.

The ease of the battle made him even more vigilant. He did not believe that the Dark-star leader was an iron head who would attack without any preparation.

With such a small fleet, how could they get rid of an enemy that even Star Cluster Civilizations had a headache over?

It couldn't be that he was tired of living and came up to deliver his head!

At this moment, the Dark-star leader, who was dodging the Mech Legion's attacks, suddenly made a gesture to Han Xiao from afar. Several strange spell waves hit Han Xiao at lightning speed.

You have been hit by the Dark-star leader's [Chain of Pain — Mystic]. Assessing MYS … failed. Your MYS is lower than the opponent's. The spell has taken effect.

[Chain of Pain — Mystic]: When the opponent takes damage, your health will decrease according to the percentage of the opponent's health. Every time the opponent loses 1% of their health, you will lose 0.55% – 0.7% of your health.

You have been hit by the Dark-star leader's [Life Absorption-Transfer]. Assessing MYS … failed. Your MYS is lower than the opponent's. The spell has taken effect.

[Life Absorption-Transfer]: When you recover your health, the recovery effect will decrease by 30%. The opponent will share this 30% recovery effect. When you theoretically recover 1,000 health, the actual effect is 700 health. At the same time, the enemy will recover 300 health.

You have been hit by the Dark-star leader's [Heart Curse — Collapse]. Assessing MYS … failed. Your MYS is lower than the opponent's. The spell has taken effect. You have entered the [Mind Collapse] state!

[Mind Collapse]: Your Psychic Resistance has decreased by 40%. You have lost control of your body and are unable to do anything. Duration: 6.2s.

Han Xiao's Mechanical Force suddenly disappeared. His limbs did not listen to him, and he froze on the spot. Han Xiaoxin was shocked. He suddenly remembered that he had the Dark-star leader's Character Summon Card, and it just so happened to be this [Heart Curse — Collapse].

He could not move at all. The Mech Legion had temporarily lost the Mechanical Force bonus, and the pressure on the Dark-star leader was greatly reduced. He barely managed to break out of the encirclement. His Magic Shield was destroyed time and time again, and he lost a certain amount of health. Through [Chain of Pain — Mystic], Han Xiao's health also decreased by a percentage.

Looking at the combat information on the interface, Han Xiao quickly calculated in his mind.

This [Chain of Pain] restores health by percentage. On average, the percentage of health I lose is about sixty percent of the Dark-star leader's, but my total health is more than double of this guy's. On the other hand, Life Drain restores health based on the actual amount of health I regenerate. I regenerate seven hundred health points, and he regenerates three hundred. However, from a percentage perspective, my health regeneration rate is actually about the same as his …

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. This meant that once he regenerated his health, both of them would lose health at the same rate. At most, he would be slightly slower.

It did not seem difficult to break this cycle. As long as he did not regenerate his health, he could just charge forward.

This time, the Dark-star leader raised his hand, and a warm Radiance spread all over his body. His wounds started to heal, and his health slowly increased.

Seeing this, Han Xiao frowned. If the enemy could heal himself, he would not share the healing power of the enemy. This way, if he wanted to kill the Dark-star leader, he would have to take some risks …

Of course, if he only wanted to capture him, it would be much simpler.

The Dark-star leader's style was obviously a Curse Mage. No matter what, he was still one of the BOSS-level characters in Version 2.0. This ability was even more of a headache for Han Xiao than Ashes, and he was better at one-on-one fights.

Let's capture him first.

A thought flashed through Han Xiao's mind, and he decided to play it safe.

No matter how good the Dark-star leader's health regeneration was, his energy was not infinite. Chain of Pain and Life Drain required continuous energy consumption, and millions of mechanical soldiers could easily drain him dry.

The effect of Heart Curse soon disappeared, and Han Xiao regained his mobility. He controlled the Mech Legion to surround and intercept the Dark-star leader. His attacks immediately increased by several levels, and the Dark-star leader was once again in a dangerous situation.

Because of the Chain of Pain, Han Xiao was not aiming to kill this time. Instead, he was trying to wear down the Dark-star leader's mana. Therefore, the Dark-star leader was barely hanging on. Otherwise, he would have been turned into ashes by the continuous True Damage.

Han Xiao did not use the Dark-star leader's Character Summon Card to deal with the enemy. The Dark-star leader's main attribute was Mystery, which was much higher than his own, so it would definitely fail.

"Could it be that he thinks he's accomplished in magic and that he's bold enough to come here alone to kill me? He can't be that reckless, right?

Although the Dark-star leader's method surprised him, it was not much of a threat. Looking at the Dark-star leader who was surrounded, Han Xiao could not help but guess the opponent's trump card.

Suddenly, a sense of vigilance rose in Han Xiaoxin. The Dark-star leader suddenly took out a black bead from his arms. Its texture was like a crystal, and the bead was filled with dense black fog. At the center was a red dot of light.

The next moment, the Dark-star leader crushed the bead, and a cloud of black fog gushed out with the red dot of light. It quickly turned into a pitch-black humanoid creature with black smoke all over its body. It did not have any facial features, and in the center of its face was a flashing red dot.

A strange and tyrannical pressure swept out, and Han Xiao only felt the hair on his back stand up. It was as if he was being stared at by some kind of evil existence.

This was pressure that originated from the difference in life form!

"What is this thing!" Harrofal, who had been watching from the sidelines, could not help but speak in the communication channel. His tone was shocked, and he subconsciously adopted a battle stance.

Han Xiao did not answer, and his eyes were extremely solemn.

At his current level, only one kind of creature could give him this kind of pressure …

Beyond Grade A!

The Mech Legion fired another round of attacks at the Dark-star leader and the black fog figure beside him. The black fog figure moved and grabbed the Dark-star leader's shoulder. With a flash of red light, the two of them suddenly teleported and appeared in another location, dodging this wave of attacks.

"This bead is indeed useful!" The Dark-star leader's tense heartstrings immediately relaxed.

This black fog figure was an Esper Ability doppelganger of the Lord of Fallen Ark. In order to create a Super High Risk Esper Ability, it had absorbed countless Esper Abilities and had countless mysterious abilities.

The Dark-star leader had seen the Lord of Fallen Ark in action before. It was practically omnipotent. He only had one word to describe what he had seen.

God!

The doppelganger of the Lord of Fallen Ark was the biggest trump card in this attack on Black Star!

The organization that planned this assassination was Dark-star's backer — the Klent Kingdom!

Supporting Dark-star to deal with the Godora Civilization was one of Klent's projects to disrupt the security of the Colton Star Cluster. Dark-star was just one of the chess pieces used to weaken the various Star Systems in the Colton Star Cluster. The Klent Kingdom had been secretly dealing with the Amethyst Civilization since a long time ago.

After Dark-star was destroyed by Han Xiao, it was also Klent who found a way to send the Dark-star leader away and sent him to the Fallen Ark.

Klent had a secret relationship with the Fallen Ark. They did not place all their bets on the Tyrant. Due to the reputation of the Fallen Ark, this secret partner would not be exposed.

After the Dark-star leader returned with his troops, he had been hiding in Klent's territory, using Klent's intelligence channels to find out about Han Xiao's whereabouts. However, Bloodshed Land did not know about this.

Han Xiao was the common thorn in the eyes of both the Dark-star leader and Klent. Both parties were like patient hunters, observing Han Xiao's movements. They discovered that in recent years, Han Xiao would occasionally head to the Wormhole Zone in the Taralam Star Cluster to look for Harrofal.

Therefore, Klent thought of a plan. Black Star had already proven that he was very difficult to kill, so why not exile him?

Some time ago, Bloodshed Land's tactic of bringing Han Xiao to the Sol Cluster was the same as Klent's idea.

In order to complete this plan, Klent secretly made a deal with the Lord of Fallen Ark and obtained one of his Esper Ability doppelgangers. Because they could not command the Tyrant, Klent found another Beyond Grade A that was secretly cooperating with them to help.

Although the Lord of Fallen Ark's doppelganger had the strength of a Beyond Grade A Super, its energy was limited. Unless he personally arrived, it would not be able to kill Black Star with just one doppelganger.

Klent's plan was to use this doppelganger to suppress Black Star, send him into the Wormhole Zone, and banish him from the Shattered Star Ring. One had to know that the Wormhole Zone was not only connected to the explored universe but also the vast and desolate unexplored universe!

Under such circumstances, the Dark-star leader accepted Klent's order and brought the Lord of Fallen Ark's doppelganger to follow Han Xiao to the Wormhole Zone in the Taralam Star Cluster to launch an attack!

The reason he was willing to work for Klent was because only with the intervention of a Star Cluster civilization would they be able to build a new home for the hybrids.

Originally, he thought that Klent would allow him to build a hybrid Godora home in the Sol Cluster. However, Klent's offer this time was something he could not reject.

If they successfully banished Black Star, Klent would build their own civilization for the hybrid Godora in the future Flickering World!

Looking at the retreating Mech Legion and the extremely alert Han Xiao, the Dark-star leader then looked at the black fog figure beside him that was emitting a terrifying aura. His thin lips curled up.
